SELECT firstname, lastname, email, phone FROM public."customer" WHERE email = 'admin@admin.com';

SELECT 
    CO.orderid,
    TO_CHAR(CO.orderedat, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') as OrderDate,
    CO.selectedaddress,
    STRING_AGG(MI.Name || ' (x' || ORDI.Amount::text || ')', ', ') as Items,
		CO.totalcost
FROM public.customerorder CO
JOIN public.ordereditem ORDI ON CO.orderid = ORDI.orderid
JOIN public.menuitem MI ON ORDI.itemid = MI.itemid
JOIN public.customer C ON CO.customerid = C.customerid
WHERE C.email = 'admin@admin.com'
GROUP BY CO.orderid, CO.orderedat, CO.selectedaddress;
